title: A layer under the skin
hook: A layer can slow a journey out of the body.

knows: Animals have body structures and life histories.
doesNotKnow: Explain blubber as a layer that can slow heat loss.

misconception: A familiar animal feature always has the first explanation that comes to mind.
objective: Explain blubber as a layer that can slow heat loss.

claims.text: What can a thick blubber layer help a marine mammal do in cold water? The cutaway places blubber between the warmer body and the water. The layer can slow outward heat transfer. It does not stop heat loss entirely, and the drawing does not estimate the rate for a particular species.
claims.source: Source lead, not checked: NOAA Fisheries, marine mammal adaptations, https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/

claims.text: The diagram and its labels are schematic, not to scale and not an observation. Cross-section · schematic
A marine mammal has a thick insulating layer under its skin. What is a reasonable thermal effect? An insulating blubber layer can slow heat loss; it does not eliminate it.
claims.source: Source lead, not checked: NOAA Fisheries, marine mammal adaptations, https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/
